1.title: CVE-2026-130071 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary: TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the guest-whitelisted update_doc method that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify any document. Attackers can supply a doctype, name and arbitrary fields that are saved with ignore_permissions=True, altering User records to escalate privileges, take over accounts or tamper with business data.

1.title: CVE-2026-130072 (CVSS 9.1)
1.summary: Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss or denial of service.

1.title: CVE-2026-79614 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in “libclinkc.so” in Zyxel DX3301-T0/EX3301-T0 firmware versions through 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0 could allow an unauthenticated attacker to elevate privileges and potentially execute arbitrary commands by sending a crafted HTTP request. WAN access is disabled by default on these devices.

1.title: CVE-2026-130583 (CVSS 9.3)
1.summary: Rootways Authorize.net CIM Pro extension for Magento 2 before 4.1.5 contains an unauthenticated server-side request forgery vulnerability in the Apple Pay merchant validation controller. Attackers can supply file://, gopher://, or dict:// URLs in the validationUrl parameter to read app/etc/env.php credentials and encryption keys or reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

1.title: CVE-2026-130587 (CVSS 9.9)
1.summary: OpenFunction through 1.2.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows namespace tenants to create privileged host-access pods by supplying unrestricted PodSpec templates in Function and Serving resources. Attackers with only Function or Serving create permissions can set privileged, hostNetwork, hostPID, or hostPath fields to mount the worker node's root filesystem and escalate to node access.

1.title: GHSA-c94f-87xg-65wf — Silverstripe Framework: RCE via i18nTextCollectorTask writer parameter
1.summary:
### Impact
The writer option of the i18nTextCollectorTask dev task was passed to the injector without validation. A crafted dev task URL could create arbitrary objects with attacker-controlled constructor arguments and run code on the server. Because the dev task did not ask for confirmation, an administrator could be tricked into running it by following a link. On a site in dev mode, no login was needed. CMS 5 is not affected.

### Reported by
Jack Wallace

1.summary:
termux-sync restore trusts fields inside an untrusted backup manifest and uses them as the extraction destination without validation.

1.title: GHSA-jq3q-62jc-fqq9 — code-review-mcp-server: Command injection via unsanitized folderPath/baseBranch parameters
1.summary:
### Impact

`code-review-mcp-server` exposes MCP tools (`getLocalGitDiff`, `codeReview`, `createPR`, `getPRTemplate`) that accept `folderPath` and `baseBranch` string parameters. These caller-controlled values were interpolated directly into shell command strings executed via `child_process.execSync()`, which runs commands through `/bin/sh`.

A crafted value such as `baseBranch = "main; <arbitrary command> #"` (or a `$(...)` command substitution, or a `folderPath` that breaks out of the surrounding quotes) results in **arbitrary command execution** on the host running the MCP server.

1.summary:
### Summary

LightSaml 5.0.0 (latest release; also confirmed on 4.6.1) validates an inbound `samlp:Response` by collecting its direct-child `saml:Assertion` elements and validating each one's `ds:Signature` via robrichards/xmlseclibs. 1.title: GHSA-7mxv-7h3q-9324 — NLTK dot2img runs Graphviz 'dot' without the trusted-exec chokepoint, enabling local code execution via a writable PATH element
1.summary:
## Summary

`nltk.parse.dependencygraph.dot2img` invokes the Graphviz `dot` executable without the trusted-execution guarantees that NLTK applies to its other native-tool wrappers.
